title: Database Administrator
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

● Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade database systems.

● Monitor database performance, availability, capacity, and overall system health.

● Proactively identify potential database performance issues, bottlenecks, and risks, and clearly communicate findings to System Administrators and/or software vendors when resolution requires action from the respective parties.

● Manage database users, roles, permissions, and access controls.

● Perform regular database backups and ensure disaster recovery readiness.

● Maintain database security, integrity, and confidentiality.

● Troubleshoot database issues and minimize system downtime.

● Optimize SQL queries and overall database performance.

● Support application teams with database-related requirements and troubleshooting.

● Maintain accurate database documentation, configuration details, and change records.

● Ensure compliance with company IT and security policies.

**Key Requirements**

● Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field with **5+ year experience** .

● Experience with SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar database management systems.

● Prior experience in administering databases with large transactional volumes and high-

volume database environments.

● Strong knowledge of SQL, database backup and recovery, security, and performance tuning.

● Good troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

● Ability to identify database performance bottlenecks and coordinate effectively with

System Administrators, application teams, and software vendors.

● Knowledge of high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) solutions is preferred.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Database Administrator - Immediate Joiner
description:
* Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain database servers across production, testing, and development environments.
* Monitor database performance and optimise queries, indexes, and configurations.
* Implement and manage backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures, including regular restoration testing.
* Configure and maintain high availability and replication solutions.
* Manage database access, user permissions, and security controls.
* Troubleshoot database incidents, identify root causes, and implement preventive measures.
* Plan and execute database migrations, patching, and version upgrades with minimal downtime.
* Monitor storage utilisation, database growth, and capacity requirements.
* Work with developers to review database schemas, stored procedures, and SQL queries.
* Automate routine administration, monitoring, and maintenance tasks.
* Maintain documentation covering database configurations, procedures, and recovery plans.
* Provide on-call and after-hours support for critical incidents and planned maintenance when required.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your current Salary?
* What is your Expected Salary?
* If Selected, In how many days you will be able to join us?

Experience:

* Database administration: 4 years (Required)

Work Location: In person
